purpose: Instrumentation of the external corrective feedback loop developing Horizon, per the 2026-11-28 reviewer suggestion: the engineering process is itself an experimental subject and a reference architecture for Horizon's internal improvement process. Append-only; every future correction event adds an entry.

field_notes.latency_minutes: detection-to-fix; detection timestamped by the detecting commit when one exists, otherwise approximated by the fix commit (noted per event)
field_notes.regression_test: whether a deterministic test now fails if the defect reappears

events.detected: 2026-11-27 (approximated by fix commit; reproduction preceded it same day)
events.verification: full CPU suite; regression test covers the exact sequence

events.defect: Stale-emission metric artifact: renderer counted legitimate resolved outputs as stale emissions by searching for the cached label without restricting to stale scenarios
events.verification: corrected metric 0; no prompts or behavioral grades changed

events.defect: Four replay-fidelity defects: retrieve(at_tick) reported end-state chain-head status (3 cases: selfedit refutation visible at tick 20, contract refutation visible at its own preregistration tick, bus support visible before the fix); initial interpretations took the internal op-counter tick instead of the declared availability tick
events.verification: full re-run with both result sets preserved; 3 catches -> 0; digest comparison
events.notes: fourth defect (availability inheritance) surfaced while authoring the regression tests

events.defect: retrieve() match keys leaked future state: target-component matching ignored attempt availability; dependency matching used the current chain head's dependencies at replay ticks
events.verification: independently verified in ac926ff: fast-forward merge, 281/281, frozen preflight digest byte-identical
events.notes: latent in the current corpus (constant dependency frames); would surface with dependency-revising chains — exactly the planned SIM-01 corpus expansion

events.defect: Amaranth smoke test failed on Windows: text-mode pipes translated LF to CRLF in builtin-yosys stdin; deprecated yosys pass name
events.verification: automation-run smoke test itself is the executing check
events.notes: outside ai-research; included for loop-level instrumentation completeness

summary_v1.honest_notes: N is too small for statistical claims; latencies are commit-timestamp approximations; two events (QA-004, QA-005) are same-session detection-plus-fix, which understates true detection-to-fix latency. The dominant defect class is replay fidelity — the present overwriting the past at replay time — which is now guarded by tests from both the preflight and the automation sides.
